author: Cleo Abram
description:
What time is it in Antarctica? All of the timezones meet here at the bottom of the world, so, could you run through all of them? Is it every time zone?

I went to Antarctica! We’re making a longer episode all about what’s hidden underneath the ice… so subscribe to see it… 

#shorts #science #antarctica #time #southpole
title: What Time Is It In Antarctica?
